rationale: Retain the paired Revolution Wind and South Fork Wind record while correcting its legal-entity boundary and complete ownership history. GIP IV Whale/designated affiliates bought Eversource's 50% interests in both project LLCs at the September 30, 2024 closing, and Skyborn manages GIP's interests. Ørsted retains the other 50% of each project. BlackRock's October 2024 acquisition of GIP was an upstream manager transaction and did not create a separate BlackRock project ownership period. South Fork is operating and Revolution began delivering power in March 2026; no later project sale or signed pending exit was found.

companyFieldUpdates.description: Revolution Wind & South Fork Wind is a paired manager-level record for two separate contracted U.S. offshore-wind project companies: Revolution Wind, LLC and South Fork Wind, LLC. South Fork is a 132 MW, 12-turbine project serving Long Island that entered commercial operation on March 14, 2024. Revolution is a 704 MW, 65-turbine project serving Rhode Island and Connecticut; it first delivered power on March 13, 2026 and was more than 95% complete in August 2026. GIP IV Whale/designated affiliates acquired Eversource's 50% interests in both projects on September 30, 2024, with Skyborn Renewables managing those interests. Ørsted retains the other 50% of each project, and Eversource is retained as the former 50% partner. BlackRock's acquisition of GIP closed after the project transaction and did not create a separate BlackRock ownership period. No later sale or signed pending exit was identified through August 23, 2026.
